result.reason: Agent reasoning failed: Backend agent endpoint failed: HTTP 422

summary.note: The real reasoner run did NOT reach verified SUCCESS. This is recorded as-is and is NOT replaced with a scripted success.

diagnosis.rootCause: BackendAgentProvider hardcodes its endpoint to 127.0.0.1:8010. The harness backend was first started on 8061, so the request went elsewhere; on a retry at 8010 that port was already held by a foreign process, so the harness backend never bound and an empty backend log confirms it produced no output. A 422 therefore came from something that is not this backend.
diagnosis.secondaryCause: The harness hand-built an AgentContextPayload; the backend's AgentContextPayload is a strict extra=forbid Pydantic model, so a synthesised context is also a plausible 422 source. Not isolated, because the port conflict made the first failure ambiguous.
diagnosis.whatThisDoesAndDoesNotShow: This is NOT evidence that the real reasoner is broken. The model was never invoked, so nothing can be concluded about real-reasoner long-horizon behaviour from this run. It is recorded as NOT_PROVEN. No scripted proposer was substituted in its place.
diagnosis.notFixedBecause: Requires freeing port 8010 and driving the context through the production buildSanitizedAgentContext/minimizeAgentContext path rather than a hand-built object. That is harness work outside the 17.4 reliability change set, and this phase does not claim the result.
